esp32.detail: 5 pins wired; XGZP6847A gauge pressure sensor needs at least 4.75 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.OUT → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 33 kΩ / 68 kΩ divider on OUT: it swings to 5 V, and the D32 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the xgzp6847a.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the gauge pressure set on the slider: passes
